title: RT @ConcretumR: In our new article, we share the Python code to backtest a 100-year trend-following strategy across U.S.
snippet:
RT @ConcretumR: In our new article, we share the Python code to backtest a 100-year trend-following strategy across U.S. sectors.

This piece is inspired by our paper, A Century of Profitable Industry Trends, co-authored with @GaryAntonacci  and recipient of the 2025 @CMTAssociation Charles H. Dow Award.

We’re sharing the full backtest code, together with 100 years of historical data.

You can run it directly online and change the parameters as you like. You will quickly discover that the parameter choices used in the paper were far from optimal.

Read the article, build your own version, and share your results!

Full article in the first comment 👇

title: RT @ConcretumR: 🏆 2025 CMT Charles H. Dow Award 🏆
snippet:
RT @ConcretumR: 🏆 2025 CMT Charles H. Dow Award 🏆

Extremely proud to share that our paper “A Century of Profitable Industry Trends” has been awarded the 2025 Charles H. Dow Award by the @CMTAssociation, the leading global association for technical analysis.

This recognition is especially meaningful because, over the years, this same award has celebrated research by traders and quantitative thinkers who inspired me early in my career — from Larry Williams to Andrew Thrasher, Larry Connors, @leadlagreport, and @charliebilello, among others.

A heartfelt thank you goes to my co-author @GaryAntonacci  the father of Dual Momentum Investing, for sharing with me his incredible knowledge and wisdom in quantitative research, particularly around trend-following models. Writing this manuscript together has been a journey of passion and enthusiasm — hopefully the first of many more!

We look forward to presenting this work at the CMT Spring Summit 2026.

For those interested in exploring our research, in the comments you find some useful materials.

✉️ If you have any questions, feel free to DM me or contact me at carlo@concretumgroup.com

@_TBone_Pickens  #CMTAssociation #TechnicalAnalysis #QuantResearch #MomentumInvesting #TrendFollowing #DualMomentum
